title: 考研英语必考核心词
description: 考研真题熟词生义与长难句核心词汇汇总

words.translation: n. 悖论，反论；看似矛盾却正确的情况
words.example: It is a curious paradox that drinking hot tea cools you down.
words.exampleTrans: 喝热茶反而能让人凉快，真是一个奇怪的悖论。

words.translation: adj. 看似合理的，合情理的；巧言令色的
words.example: Her explanation sounded plausible at first hearing.
words.exampleTrans: 她的解释初听起来似乎很合情理。

words.translation: adj. 怀疑的，持怀疑态度的
words.example: Scientists are skeptical about the dramatic claim.
words.exampleTrans: 科学家们对这种耸人听闻的说法持怀疑态度。

words.translation: adj. 不可避免的，必然发生的；照例的
words.example: Technological disruption is an inevitable part of progress.
words.exampleTrans: 技术颠覆是进步过程中不可避免的一部分。

words.example: There is a growing consensus that reform is necessary.
words.exampleTrans: 越来越多的人达成共识，认为改革势在必行。

words.translation: vt. 仔细检查，认真审视
words.example: The committee will scrutinize every detail of the agreement.
words.exampleTrans: 委员会将严加审视协议的每一个细节。

words.translation: adj. 前所未有的，空前的
words.example: The pandemic caused unprecedented economic disruption.
words.exampleTrans: 疫情造成了前所未有的经济动荡。

words.example: This discovery represents a shift in our scientific paradigm.
words.exampleTrans: 这一发现代表了我们科学范式的转变。

words.translation: adj. 显眼的，引人注目的
words.example: She felt very conspicuous in her bright red dress.
words.exampleTrans: 穿著鲜艳的红裙子让她觉得格外引人注目。

words.translation: n. 顿悟，突然的大彻大悟
words.example: He had an epiphany while walking alone in the quiet forest.
words.exampleTrans: 独自在安静的森林里散步时，他突然顿悟了。

words.example: He condemned the hypocrisy of politicians making false promises.
words.exampleTrans: 他谴责了政客们做虚假承诺的虚伪面目。

words.translation: n. 普遍存在，无所不在
words.example: The ubiquity of social media has changed how we socialize.
words.exampleTrans: 社交媒体的无所不在改变了我们的社交方式。
